items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: Well, there was Gretsch, but they didn't have very much of a name during that time.

ctx.x: What about the other equipment, like your snare drum...? What were the sets...? Was the Gretsch Company... They were active at that time, weren't they? Gretsch?
Well, there was Gretsch, but they didn't have very much of a name during that time. It's always been an expensive drum, because it's a good drum. But the drum I mostly use is a Ludwig.
